practiceName: Choose a suitable tool or approach
title: Retry decision rules refuse metadata drift and non-retryable states
turnSequence: A draft settles in failed-retryable against the real persistence (deterministic fixture provider).
The teacher retries with a changed prompt (metadata drift).
A separate draft reaches ready-for-review; the teacher retries it anyway.
expected: The metadata-drift retry is refused with 409 RETRY_METADATA_MISMATCH and the ready-for-review retry is refused with 409 DRAFT_NOT_RETRYABLE; neither attempt starts a provider call or mutates the record.
observableFailure: A drifted retry silently replaces the original request, or a finished draft can be retried and re-drafted without the teacher's new request.
flipCondition: Requires a migrated, seeded PostgreSQL reachable at DATABASE_URL; unblocks when the database is available.
